title: The differentiation and integration operator on weighted spaces of analytic functions in the weight sequence setting
summary: We investigate the differentiation and integration operator defined on resp. between weighted spaces of analytic functions in the special situation when the weight is given in terms of a weight sequence. More precisely, in this case the weight is defined via the associated weight function which is a crucial object in the ultradifferentiable setting and the information can be then expressed purely in terms of the underlying weight sequence.
